name: Plans
description: Sellable packages per product (Turkish only). Prices are KDV hariç, in TRY. Leave price_try empty until the owner sets prices; the site then shows 'Teklif iste'. iyzico_link empty → no 'Satın al' button. Only plans of live products are sold. Auto-renewal must not auto-charge consumers on fixed-term plans (Abonelik Yön. md.13).

iyzico_link.description: iyzico payment link (Phase A). Empty = no buy button.

note.description: e.g. 'Her yıl TÜFE/ÜFE ile güncellenir', taksit notu.

price_try.description: KDV hariç TL. Boş = fiyat henüz yayında değil.
